evidence: Accurate and fast occupancy bits and mutated masks match the compiled original C++ on bounded synthetic cases. Analytic silhouette intersection, monotonicity, exports and old vector-cache regressions are tested. A declaration-only compatibility header allows carving compilation; missing marching-cubes meshing is not implemented.
